_about: Water traversal & dive annex (List 20 #192) to #123's mochiichao/traversal/v1 — the same format family, not a rival system. Eligibility is derived from species-sheet anatomy + #43 size class; there is no species list. The fragment instances no route, gate, or dive area.

diveArea.record: a #119 interior record; rooms are depth strata
diveArea.state: #61 terms — surface weather_state inherited at the threshold; below-surface light/pressure are presentation fields, values OPEN

divePoint.gateKind: dive — proposed into the #11 edge / #59 lock vocabularies (lands in their owners' files)
divePoint.performance: a live party member must be dive-eligible by anatomy — always required
divePoint.permission: IF an owner ruling ever names a dive technique, its #12 tech.* fact is required (#117's held/performed discipline verbatim); the technique roster here is OPEN with zero rows

eligibility.dive: sheet anatomy supports descent (pressure / breath fields as recorded on the sheet)
eligibility.rule: derived, never listed — a species is traversable exactly when its sheet says its body can do it
eligibility.surface: sheet anatomy records aquatic locomotion AND #43 size class bears a rider (#123's test, unchanged)
eligibility.unaidedSwim: OPEN — whether a Ranger swims alone is a canon question this package does not answer

encountersBelow: the host area's #7 table through a proposed `dive` method slot (#7 schema, its home decides) — zero rows; a dive invents no fauna
region1Instance: the waters around the Seven Mochii Isles — contents OPEN per #66 (seven named slots, zero invented); this package instances no isle water
